name: Polish MCP Servers
description: Stdio MCP server for Polish law and public registers. 14 read-only tools: company lookup by NIP, REGON or KRS in the GUS REGON register (BIR1.2), new and changed KRS companies, Sejm ELI legal acts, SAOS court judgments, EU-funds tenders (Baza Konkurencyjności), CEE public tenders, EIPA EV charging stations, aggregated CEPiK vehicle registrations, GUNB building permits, ULDK land parcels with MPZP/POG zoning, RPWDL healthcare facilities, developer apartment prices and PSE electricity market data. tools/list needs no token; each tools/call runs a public Apify Actor billed pay-per-event to the Apify account behind APIFY_TOKEN.
author: kamilkaczmareksolutions

APIFY_TOKEN.description: Apify API token used to run the Apify Actor behind each tool call. Create one at https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Not needed for tools/list.
